text: 创业板指、科创50均跌超1%，沪指跌0.16%，深成指跌0.78%，AI应用、算力租赁、影视、软件开发等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超3600只
text_en: ChiNext Index and STAR 50 both fall over 1%, Shanghai Composite down 0.16%, Shenzhen Component down 0.78%; AI applications, computing power leasing, film and television, and software development lead losses; over 3,600 stocks fall across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
